causal.question: What recurring within-person activity–sleep effect is compatible with a fitted longitudinal model?
causal.action_space: Specified within-person physical-activity exposure contrasts; model-generated randomization.
causal.estimand: Recurring individual treatment effect under serial interference, averaged over repeated occasions.
causal.identification_assumptions: Consistency of the specified exposure contrast; sufficient measured history for sequential exchangeability; overlap/positivity; appropriate handling of timing, carryover, missingness and model specification. These are applicability conditions, not verified guarantees.
causal.validation_scope: Simulations and the authors’ longitudinal Fitbit step/sleep histories.
causal.evidence_boundary: Model-twin randomization is computational. Observational identification and fitted-model assumptions remain; no real randomized sleep intervention is established.
